title: SourceCreate
description: API-key Source creation input. It extends the unsaved observation request with display, reconciliation, and explicit unavailable-inventory consent data; the server still owns Source identity, protocol, discovered inventory, health, usage, custody metadata, and timestamps. Optional protocol restricts observation to one interface; omission auto-detects across the supported interfaces. A supplied protocol is persisted when observation is authenticated and either vendor has a shipped catalog pin for that protocol, the client declared it on custom, or a matching protocol-shaped upstream response proves it. Auto-detect without a catalog pin still requires matching response proof. When client_nonce is present, the server reserves it atomically in process before observation or credential work; only a successful commit persists Source.client_nonce unchanged. A lost-response client reconciles through the ordinary Source list without a receipt or separate endpoint. Nonce uniqueness covers live-process reservations and live Sources; process restart or Source deletion releases it, and a later same-nonce request after the required list read is a fresh create.

vendor.description: Vendor id used by the response-backed observation.

display_name.description: Optional user-facing name. Omission uses the server's canonical vendor label.

base_url.description: null selects the vendor's official endpoint; a custom value selects a relay or self-hosted endpoint.

key.description: Transient plaintext credential. It is never returned or persisted in Source state.

protocol.description: Optional user-selected or catalog-pinned interface. When present, observation probes exactly this protocol. Persistence requires authentication plus one of: a shipped vendor catalog pin for this protocol, a declaration on vendor custom, or matching protocol-shaped upstream response proof. Omission auto-detects across the authoritative protocol vocabulary and still requires matching response proof.

client_nonce.description: Optional client-generated create correlation held before submission. The server atomically reserves it in process before observation or credential work and writes Source.client_nonce only on successful commit; no durable pre-create claim record exists. A lost-response client reads Sources before retrying. A same-nonce retry receives an in-progress conflict, atomically reclaims a released slot as a fresh create, or receives a committed conflict and reconciles by finding that nonce in the ordinary Source list. Uniqueness applies only while a live-process reservation or live Source exists; process restart and Source deletion release it. It is not Source identity, credential material, or a routing input.

accept_unavailable_inventory.description: Optional explicit consent to commit only when the server's repeated response-backed observation proves a protocol but inventory discovery fails. Omission or false rejects that cell with discovery_failed; true permits a Source with models: []. The flag never supplies observation evidence, has no effect on a successful discovery, and cannot bypass reachability, authentication, or protocol proof.
